properties.description: The outline a control takes under the keyboard (`:focus-visible`), in the brand filled colour; each rule sets its own offset. from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.description: Lines and borders of the architecture diagram: its edges and adapter cards. Gray 6 / dark 2, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.description: Background of a building-block card in the architecture diagram. White / dark 6, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.description: Stroke of a module's hexagon and its cards in the architecture diagram. Brand 3 / brand 8, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-architecture-core
properties.description: Fill of the domain core inside a module's hexagon. Brand 1 / dark 7, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-architecture-core-border
properties.description: Stroke of the domain core and its cards. Brand 4 / brand 7, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-architecture-selection
properties.description: What marks the selected element in the architecture diagram, and what relates to it: Mantine's orange filled colour, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-requirement-quote
properties.description: Background of a quoted need or rule statement in the requirements view. Gray 0 / dark 6, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-requirement-gap
properties.description: Text and underline of a gap in the requirements view — a need no rule traces to. Red 8 / red 4, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.
